notes: No package.json/build/React in this repo. design-system/ is a set of static, self-contained HTML preview pages (already carrying @dsCard markers) generated by tools/build-design-system.py from inline Python templates, plus design-system/tokens.css. There is no compiled component API to bind, so this project was synced by hand: styles.css <- tokens.css, README.md <- DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, and each design-system/**/*.html copied through unchanged (paths minus the design-system/ prefix). No _ds_bundle.js, no .jsx/.d.ts, no _ds_sync.json anchor -- a future re-sync should re-copy the same files rather than expecting the converter's automated shape.
